Sözleşmelerin sona ermesi, Şirketimizin bu iş birliğinden doğan mevcut alacaklarını ve yasal haklarını ortadan kaldırmamaktadır. Legal proceedings, enforcement proceedings and other legal processes initiated to protect our Company's rights and interests and to collect its receivables are ongoing. Our Company continues to conduct its commercial activities in line with its principles of financial discipline, sustainable growth and corporate objectives.
